name: move-continuation-boundary-classification
purpose: Classify every current move proof/product row as continuation, resource-reconstruction, reexec, or refusal so product move continuation claims can exclude non-continuation behavior.

classificationDefinitions.continuation: modeled live execution/resource state continuation, not mere target restart or target output reconstruction
classificationDefinitions.resource-reconstruction: finite resource, cursor, file/tree, pipe buffer, or semantic state reconstructed on the target without live execution continuation
classificationDefinitions.reexec: target-native process/service/listener restart or reexec from validated executable, argv, cwd, data, listener, and health evidence
classificationDefinitions.refusal: negative, unsafe, unsupported, blocker, or probe evidence that prevents or bounds move behavior
